recent_articles.title: Suo motu case against top Karnataka officials after raids expose illegal sand mining in Bagalkot - The Hindu

The investigation followed complaints about rampant illegal mining activities in Bagalkot district and revealed indiscriminate excavation using heavy machinery in violation of environmental norms.  The **Lokayukta Police** conducted raids across Bagalkot district on May 21, seizing equipment and uncovering large quantities of illegally extracted sand. recent_articles.title: Mega merger incoming: Should you buy PFC, REC shares ahead of merger? Here's what analysts say - The Economic Times

While PFC offers better visibility due to its parent status, REC presents a merger-arbitrage opportunity with higher event risk depending on the swap ratio.

recent_articles.title: Stray dog euthanasia: Bengaluru examining legally permissible options for ‘rabid, ill, or aggressive dogs’ - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Submerged temple emerges as Bhavanisagar Dam level drops - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bhavanisagar Dam**'s water level dropping to 59 ft. has revealed the dilapidated **Sri Madhava Perumal Temple**, which was submerged during construction in the 1940s and 1950s.  A study of inscriptions on the temple premises found it to be located at the confluence of the Bhavani and Moyar rivers, once a significant trade route connecting Kongu with Karnataka and Kerala. The site is believed to have been ruled by the Hoysalas and served as the location for a fort built by **Madhava Perumal Dhandanayaka**, a general appointed by King Veera Ballala III.  The temple was last visible in 2024 when the water level dropped, and fishermen report that portions of the structure become visible again at lower water levels.

recent_articles.title: Insensitivity and lack of concern, alleges Congress on Center’s silence over U.P. storm deaths - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Monsoon to reach Kerala on May 26, says IMD - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** predicts the southwest monsoon will advance into Kerala on May 26, a day earlier than its usual June 1 arrival.  While this year's monsoon onset is anticipated to be early, there are concerns about below-normal rainfall. The IMD has historically been accurate in predicting the monsoon's arrival over Kerala, with only one exception in 2015. **M. Ravichandran**, Secretary of the Ministry of Earth Sciences, stated that after the monsoon onset, a period of heavy rain is expected for the next five days.  The IMD has warned of potential drought impacts due to reduced rainfall and the ongoing El Nino phenomenon.

recent_articles.title: Joyride horse dies of highly contagious zoonotic disease disease in Chennai; Tamil Nadu goes into alert mode - The Hindu

The NRCE advised the Tamil Nadu Animal Husbandry Department to isolate and monitor all equines in the area, implement surveillance and testing protocols, and regulate inter-state movement of horses. **The Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board** has requested that samples be collected from all joyride horses.

recent_articles.title: Election results 2026: Why welfare policies aren't winning polls in India like it used to
recent_articles.rephrased_article: India's welfare politics, once a key electoral tool, is facing challenges. While cash transfers and subsidized services have become the norm across parties, recent state elections suggest that extensive welfare delivery alone is no longer enough to secure incumbency.  **Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool Congress**, for example, lost power in West Bengal despite its women-centric welfare schemes. **The Bharatiya Janata Party** has capitalized on expanding welfare architecture, including women's self-help groups and administrative efficiency, while voters are increasingly demanding more than just welfare benefits.  Political scientists argue that this shift signifies a move from the floor of Indian politics to the ceiling, where parties must build coalitions around broader issues like job creation and economic mobility.

The consultations, attended by observers **Ajay Maken** and **Mukul Wasnik**, have failed to reach a decision on the selection of a new Chief Minister despite discussions lasting over three hours.

recent_articles.title: Governor’s role in government formation | Explained - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)** secured a majority in the recent Tamil Nadu Assembly elections, but the Governor invited the party's chief to form the government.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the TVK leader, was sworn in as Chief Minister after securing letters of support from 120 members. The Governor's discretion in appointing the Chief Minister is based on constitutional provisions and previous recommendations by commissions, but there have been instances where Governors have appointed a Chief Minister without following these guidelines.  The Supreme Court has emphasized that the "floor of the House" is the appropriate forum to determine majority support for a government.

recent_articles.title: Police rescue 42 cattle, seize two vehicles in separate incidents in Peddapalli - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sultanabad police** rescued 42 bulls and cows from two separate vehicles in Peddapalli district on Sunday.  A Hyderabad-bound container lorry carrying 33 bulls was seized at a check post near Dubbapalli, while a van with 9 cows destined for an undisclosed location in Karnataka was intercepted at the same location. The police registered a case against the van's crew, Syed Shabad and Moiuddin, and transferred the rescued animals to a nearby goshala.

recent_articles.title: Congress government spending more time to solve its internal dispute rather than people’s problems, says Prime Minister Narendra Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** criticized the **Congress government in Karnataka** during a speech on Sunday, stating that it has been preoccupied with internal disputes instead of addressing the needs of its citizens. He questioned the future leadership and power dynamics within the state government, suggesting an unresolved situation.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka minister D Sudhakar passes away - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D. Sudhakar**, the Minister for Planning and Statistics of **Karnataka**, passed away on Sunday at a private hospital in Bengaluru after battling a lung infection following a knee operation. He was 66 years old.  The government has declared a three-day mourning period and a holiday for schools, colleges, and government establishments on Monday. Prominent leaders across party lines have expressed condolences, including **Randeep Singh Surjewala**, the AICC general secretary in charge of Karnataka, and **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister of **Karnataka**.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka is No 1 in revenue, panchayat services, claims Priyank Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka's** **Revenue Department** has launched a large-scale distribution drive for revenue department benefits, marking a significant achievement in delivering services to citizens.  The initiative aims to provide easier access to revenue services and empower economically weaker sections with ownership records.  **Deputy Commissioner B. Fouzia Taranum** and the entire revenue administration have played a crucial role in achieving this record level of service delivery. **Priyank Kharge**, **Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Minister**, highlighted the importance of land rights for accessing financial assistance like loans, crop insurance, and government subsidies.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi assures more support to Telangana, asks CM Revanth to collaborate with him - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** assured **Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** that the **Central government** would continue to support its development, emphasizing the importance of state-level progress for a developed India by 2047.  During his visit on May 10, 2026, **Modi** inaugurated several developmental projects worth ₹9,400 crore, including industrial parks and railway infrastructure, aiming to make Telangana a manufacturing hub. He highlighted the government's commitment to creating employment opportunities and reviving the textile industry through schemes like PM Mitra Park at Warangal and investments in infrastructure development.  The Prime Minister also emphasized the importance of energy security with the launch of the Malkapur terminal.

recent_articles.title: Inauguration of Dhyan Mandir at Art of Living: PM Modi stresses on mental wellbeing - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** emphasized the importance of mental well-being in an era of rapid technological change during the inauguration of Dhyan Mandir in Bengaluru. **Modi** stressed the need for "natural healing" of the Earth and sustainable agriculture ahead of the Monsoon season, highlighting the interconnectedness of ecology and economy. He praised the AOL founder, **Sri Sri Ravishankar**, for promoting spiritual consciousness and lauded the Swacch Bharath Abhiyan as a societal norm.

recent_articles.title: Obituary | D. Sudhakar turned political adversities into advantages - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dasharathaiah Sudhakar**, a fourth-time MLA from Karnataka, passed away on Sunday (May 10, 2026).  His political career saw him shift between parties and ultimately become a minister after defying the Congress by winning as an independent. **Sudhakar** was known for his advocacy of rainwater harvesting, having installed systems at his homes in both Chitradurga and Bengaluru. Hydrogeologist Dr. N. J. Devaraja Reddy noted that **Sudhakar** had been promoting rainwater harvesting for over two decades.

recent_articles.title: Around 1,10,787 candidates attended COMED-K UGET - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Over 110,787 candidates took the **COMED-K UGET** entrance exam across India, with approximately 35,678 in Karnataka. The exam, a gateway to admissions into 20,000 seats at engineering colleges in the state, was held in two sessions on Saturday.  The provisional answer keys will be released on May 13th and the final key on May 20th. Students can access their rank cards on May 26th.

recent_articles.title: Israel widens Gaza control, plans more ops - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Israel** has expanded its control of **Gaza**, now controlling 60% of the territory, according to officials.  Finance minister **Bezalel Smotrich** stated that this expansion is part of a strategy to deepen destruction of infrastructure and limit Hamas's ability to re-arm. The move comes despite a ceasefire agreement seven months ago aimed at rehabilitating the war-torn enclave, which has seen increased violence with continued Israeli airstrikes and Hamas resisting disarmament efforts.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka Police to prioritise housing for SC/ST personnel facing caste bias in finding rented accommodation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **ADGP Devajyoti Ray**, head of the grievance cell in the **Karnataka Police**, issued a circular directing authorities to prioritize police quarters for personnel facing caste discrimination in securing rental housing. The circular, issued on behalf of the DGP & IGP, reverses the current system of allocating housing based on seniority and addresses concerns raised during a Government Assurance Committee meeting regarding caste-based discrimination in rental housing.

recent_articles.title: Gram panchayat elections in Karnataka will be held before end of 2026, says Minister Priyank Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Priyank Kharge**, **Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Minister**, announced that the state government will hold gram panchayat elections before the end of the year.  He also stated that drinking water scarcity in Kalaburagi district is being addressed with funds from the state government, the Kalyana Karnataka Region Development Board, and recommendations from task forces headed by MLAs. **Mr. Kharge** added that a decision on expanding the State Cabinet will be made at the appropriate time by **Chief Minister Siddaramaiah** and the party high command.

recent_articles.title: Three-hour meeting fails to end impasse over Congress Chief Minister for Kerala - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite consultations between **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge, Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi, and AICC general secretary (organisation) K.C. Venugopal, senior leaders Ramesh Chennithala and V.D. Satheesan, and KPCC president Sunny Joseph, a decision on naming a Chief Minister for **Kerala** remains stalled.  The high command has until May 23 to finalize the candidate after considering claims from each faction, including those of Congress MLA-designates and constituents of the United Democratic Front (UDF). The consultations were marked by intense posturing and competing claims, with party workers removing aggressive flex boards and appeals made to maintain decorum.

recent_articles.title: Parties are equal partners in INDIA alliance, says U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ajay Rai**, Uttar Pradesh Congress president, stated that the **INDIA** alliance in Uttar Pradesh is based on equal partnership and a united effort to defeat the **BJP**. He emphasized that decisions regarding the Congress's participation will be made by the high command and that the party is focusing on strengthening its organization at the booth level for the upcoming Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: SC order on Mysuru heritage structures: MP seeks immediate restoration works - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yaduveer Krishnadatta Chamaraja Wadiyar**, **Mysuru MP**, urged **Chief Minister Siddaramaiah** to release funds and begin restoration work on the historic Devaraja Market and Lansdowne Building following a Supreme Court ruling that ordered their conservation instead of demolition. The court's decision, based on an IIT Roorkee assessment, found nearly 70% of the structures could be repaired and restored while retaining the existing foundation. **Wadiyar** emphasized the importance of preserving Mysuru’s historic architecture and urged the State government to use allocated funds exclusively for conservation efforts.

recent_articles.title: Kerala CM debate: Kharge to hold crucial talks with senior leaders today evening - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **AICC president**, will meet with key figures in the Kerala Congress leadership, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, and **Ramesh Chennithala**, on Saturday (May 9, 2026) to discuss the selection of a new Chief Minister.  **Rahul Gandhi** is expected to meet with the Kerala leaders after a consensus emerges from the meeting chaired by **Kharge**.

recent_articles.title: ‘Value‑added cashew apple products yet to reach people’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shree Padre**, a senior developmental and farm journalist, highlighted the potential of **cashew apple** despite its unutilized value-added products. He noted that **Kerala Agricultural University's Cashew Research Station** and the **Directorate of Cashew Research** have developed over 50 cashew apple products but haven't been released for commercial production.  He emphasized the opportunity for entrepreneurship in preparing zero-additive cashew apple juice, its use in ayurvedic medicine, and its potential as a vegetarian meat substitute.  The article also mentions **Kuruveri Cashews Farm** successfully producing cashew apple pulp.

recent_articles.title: TH journalist wins award - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DKMS Foundation, India**, hosted the ‘Lifesaver Honours Night’ in Bengaluru to recognize efforts strengthening the stem cell donor ecosystem. **Afshan Yasmeen**, Deputy Editor of The Hindu, received an award for her impactful reporting on thalassaemia patients in Karnataka.  The event brought together medical professionals, institutions, corporate partners and advocates working against blood cancer and blood disorders.

recent_articles.title: Congress slams Modi Government over women’s safety citing NCRB data - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party leaders, including **Mallikarjun Kharge**, criticized the **Narendra Modi Government** for its handling of women's safety and rising crime rates.  Kharge cited data from the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) showing a significant increase in crimes against women, children, Dalits, Adivasis, and cybercrime during the past decade. He accused the government of using "Beti Bachao" and "Nari Vandan" as mere slogans while failing to address these issues effectively. **Alka Lamba**, president of the All India Mahila Congress, echoed these concerns, alleging that the BJP was shielding perpetrators instead of ensuring justice for victims.

recent_articles.title: Census enumerators ID can be verified through QR code - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lalit Jain**, Director of Census Operations (DCO), **Haryana**, has introduced QR code-enabled identity cards for enumerators to address concerns about authenticity.  Jain explained that residents can verify the legitimacy of enumerators by scanning the codes on their ID cards. The first phase of the digital census, which began on April 1, aims to cover over 30 lakh households across India. Residents are legally obligated to answer Census-related questions, and while there have been no cases of FIRs for non-response, local authorities will be involved in encouraging participation.  The second phase of the census, focusing on caste enumeration, is scheduled for February 2027.

recent_articles.title: Telangana leads India in human trafficking cases, women form vast majority of victims - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana** recorded the highest number of human trafficking cases in 2024, with 423 reported incidents, a significant increase from the previous year. This was followed by **Maharashtra**, **Odisha**, **Bihar**, and **Karnataka**.  The National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) data revealed that sexual exploitation for prostitution was the primary motive behind trafficking in **Telangana**, accounting for 770 victims. The state also had the highest trafficking crime rate at 1.1 cases per lakh population, with a charge-sheeting rate of 99%.

recent_articles.title: Gurugram gated societies not letting in enumerators; FIRs recommended against enumerators obstructing Census work - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Haryana** administration has recommended an FIR against two government school staff for alleged negligence in Census-related work and obstruction of duties.  **Gurugram Municipal Corporation Joint Commissioner Punit Kumar** stated that enumerators have been denied entry into several highrise apartment buildings, prompting him to write to RWAs to ensure their access. **Registrar General of India Mritunjay Kumar Narayan** flagged off awareness vans across Delhi for the ongoing Census 2027 public outreach campaign.  The first phase of the Census began on April 1 and will conclude by September 30, involving around 30 lakh enumerators.

recent_articles.title: Congress leader Varsha Gaikwad writes to Maharashtra Governor, seeks immediate enactment of Shakti Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Varsha Gaikwad**, **Mumbai Congress president** and MP, has written to **Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma** urging urgent action on rising crimes against women in the state.  Gaikwad requested the Governor's intervention regarding the **Shakti Criminal Laws (Maharashtra Amendment) Bill, 2020**, which awaits presidential assent, and urged the government to take strict action against atrocities against women. The letter comes amid protests following a four-year-old girl's alleged rape and murder in Pune district.

recent_articles.title: Infant kidnapped in Suraram rescued within 48 hours; five arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sridevi**, 35, and four others, including two juveniles, were arrested in connection with the abduction of a six-month-old infant from Suraram.  The accused, all natives of Karnataka residing in Hyderabad, planned the kidnapping to procure a baby for **Sridevi's** sister-in-law who was struggling with infertility. The crime was premeditated and the infant was rescued after police tracked them down to a function hall in Rajendranagar.

recent_articles.title: PM to visit Bengaluru on May 10 to address 45th anniversary of Art of Living; BJP to offer reception at HAL Airport - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** will visit Bengaluru on May 10 to attend the 45th anniversary celebrations of **The Art of Living** and the 70th birthday of its founder, **Sri Sri Ravi Shankar**. The BJP State unit is preparing a reception for the Prime Minister upon his arrival at HAL Airport.  He will deliver a speech at a public event followed by an address at the Art of Living International Centre campus where he will inaugurate new facilities and participate in various programs including a meditation session for World Peace led by **Sri Sri Ravi Shankar**.

recent_articles.title: With 300 elephants outside forests, Karnataka fast-tracks rehab plan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Karnataka Forest Department** has identified a new site for a soft release center for wild elephants after the **Centre's** rejection of the proposal for Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary. The proposed facility aims to address human-elephant conflict, with around 300 elephants currently outside forest areas.  **Forest Minister Eshwar B. Khandre** stated that multiple mitigation measures are being implemented, including rail barriers and elephant-proof trenches. He also emphasized the need for cooperation from residents living near forest areas.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka’s deep tech programme ELEVATE NxT draws strong response from startups across India - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The first cohort of **ELEVATE NxT**, a national grant-in-aid program for deep tech startups by the **Department of Electronics, IT, and Bt in Karnataka**, has received applications from across India.  Of the 983 total applications, 213 are from outside Karnataka, representing nearly 23% of the total. The selected candidates will pitch to a jury on May 6, 2026, with the final cohort selection following a three-week process. **Priyank Kharge**, IT-Bt Minister of Karnataka, announced this program in January 2026 as part of the state's "Deep Tech Decade" initiative.

recent_articles.title: CM to visit Mysuru on Wednesday - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Siddaramaiah** is scheduled to visit Mysuru on Wednesday. He will participate in Shivayogi Siddarameshwara Jayanti celebrations at Kalamandira, where he will confer the Kayakayogi Sri Shivayogi Siddarameshwara award.  He will also attend a private program later that evening before departing for Bengaluru on May 7th.

recent_articles.title: Minister directs officials to expedite roadworks in Kodagu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Minister in charge of Kodagu district N.S. Boseraju** directed officials to expedite roadwork completion before monsoon season, expressing dissatisfaction with the slow pace and tarnishing the government's image. **Boseraju** also addressed concerns raised by representatives like Madikeri MLA Mantar Gowda regarding the need for swift completion of projects in his constituency, including the Aigoor bridge, Galibeedu road repair, and maintenance of roads in various areas.  He also criticized delays in power substation construction despite government releases for the **CESC** in Kodagu.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka HC upholds ‘leave India’ notice to French national who was operating restaurant while on tourist visa - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **High Court of Karnataka** upheld a "leave India" notice issued to a French national, Christophe Stephane Monxion, for operating a restaurant and engaging in commercial activities in violation of his tourist visa. The court dismissed Monxion's petition challenging the notice, citing evidence from the **Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO)** that he had repeatedly transgressed visa conditions and engaged in disputes with landowners.  The court ordered Monxion to leave India within a specified timeframe.

recent_articles.title: State grants approval to procure six MRI machines for district hospitals - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The State government** has approved the procurement of six MRI machines for district and district-level hospitals under the National Free Diagnostic Services Programme. The **Mission Director, National Health Mission (NHM)** submitted the proposal, which will be funded by ECRP-2 and ECRP-1 savings.  These units will be installed in Davanagere, Mysuru, Dharwad, Bagalkote, Jayanagar General/K.C. General Hospital in Bengaluru, and Bengaluru South. The procurement will be carried out through the **Karnataka State Medical Supplies Corporation (KSMSC)**.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet panel clears Railway Ministry’s three multitracking projects in six States - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs**, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved three multitracking projects for the **Railway Ministry** with a total cost of ₹23,437 crore. These projects will increase the existing railway network by about 901 km in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. The projects are expected to be completed by 2030-31 and will enhance connectivity to approximately 4,161 villages, improve rail connectivity to several tourist destinations, and provide seamless connectivity for people, goods, and services.

recent_articles.title: Anantapur police bust international cricket betting racket run from Philippines; 10 arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anantapur police** in India have arrested 10 individuals involved in an international cricket betting racket operating from the Philippines. The operation, led by **Superintendent of Police P Jagadeesh**, saw the seizure of ₹19.70 lakh in cash and ₹18.20 lakh in bank accounts across nine banks.  The gang, which has members across the country, used digital payment platforms to facilitate illegal betting activities through an app offering cricket betting and other banned games. The operation was initiated after police received information about the group's activities during the ongoing IPL matches. **Shiva**, a Philippines-based member of the gang, recruited local associates to collect bank accounts, SIM cards, and passbooks before sending them to the Philippines via cargo pants.

recent_articles.title: Assam poll verdict rejection of blue blood politics: Himanta Biswa Sarma - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the **Chief Minister of Assam**, attributed the **BJP's** victory in the state elections to a rejection of "blue blood" politics, claiming that voters favored the party over candidates whose fathers held previous political positions.  The BJP secured 102 seats out of 126, while several Congress candidates, including Gaurav Gogoi, Debabrata Saikia, and Diganta Barman, lost their respective constituencies. Seven women were elected to the Assam Assembly, with a success rate of 11.86%.

recent_articles.title: Woman stabbed by son-in-law for preventing him from talking to his pregnant wife - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arvind Gawali**, a man from Belagavi, Karnataka, allegedly stabbed his mother-in-law **Mahadevi** (45) after she refused to allow him to speak with his wife.  Gawali fled the scene and posted on social media that he would be released on bail the next day and target his mother-in-law again. He was subsequently arrested.

recent_articles.title: KSRTC bus gutted by fire in Karnataka, passengers safe - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **KSRTC** bus caught fire in Ranebennur taluk, Karnataka on May 5th. The incident occurred near Devaragudda while the bus was traveling from Bengaluru to Gadag.  The driver noticed smoke coming from a tire and stopped the bus, safely evacuating passengers before one of the tires exploded and the bus caught fire. Despite the driver alerting the fire brigade, the bus was completely destroyed by the time firefighters arrived.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka bypolls results 2026: Congress retains Bagalkot constituency, faulty EVMs delay counting in Davanagere South - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Umesh Meti** of the **Congress** won the Bagalkot Assembly constituency by a margin of 22,332 votes in Karnataka's by-election.  The counting of votes for the Davangere South constituency has been delayed due to technical glitches on three EVMs. The results are expected after the completion of the VVPAT tallying process. Security arrangements have been made at both counting centers to ensure a smooth and secure election outcome.
